about: Each place's municipal filing-deadline rule as data, structured from data/research/elections/filing-requirements.json (ruleText is that file's words). Kinds: days-before-election; weekday-of-month (nth, negative counts from the end; plusDays after it) in the election's year; weekday-before-election (nth such weekday before the election); fixed-date; unread (the estimate stands in: SG-GOV-filing-deadline-estimate); not-applicable. The unread rows and every ESTIMATED row are checked against the statute named when read.
